# skycloak_realm_user_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a single realm role to a user. One resource per (user, role) edge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm_user_role_assignment" "jdoe_admin" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  user_id    = skycloak_realm_user.jdoe.id
  role_name  = skycloak_realm_role.admin.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.
- `role_name` (String) Realm role name. Immutable.
- `user_id` (String) User ID. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
